acceptance_explanation.all_attempts: Exactly one attempt for each of nine ordered tasks; all terminal results and raw events retained. No silent retries, selective omission or success substitution.
acceptance_explanation.authenticity: Checker replay cannot authenticate its producer. Independent review must establish trained provenance, real execution, unchanged exact source, the pre-generation freeze, and passing required CI before milestone closure.
acceptance_explanation.feedback: Both first_recall and recall_after_correction require actual retrieval and measurable actual final; follow-up receives exactly the actual prior terminal answer and identity as untrusted context, and repeat_error/opportunity counts must be measured integers. Zero opportunities is valid; no wrong answer is manufactured.
acceptance_explanation.semantic_coverage: Each of eight intents must have an actual model-generated successful retrieval and schema-valid final with positive factual_outputs and recalled_claims. Independent task-verifier failures remain failures and do not alone reject harness coverage. Empty/malformed output cannot establish coverage.
acceptance_explanation.supersession: The superseded_preference task must pass its independent verifier, including model-owned supersession receipt and authoritative state.

change_scope: Separately reviewed supervised private-snapshot cleanup, generic policy removal of fictitious examples, and public tool-description clarification with explicit public_tools_sha256 in grammar policy identity. All four rejected campaigns remain retained. Learned weights, configuration, tokenizer, native template, request-local model cache, nine tasks, token/step/time bounds and qualification gates remain unchanged. The previously declared action-JSON profile masks only public syntax for authenticated request tools; actions, memory values, evidence IDs and task outcomes remain model-owned. No parser repair, hidden retry or generated-answer substitution.

generation.cache_lifetime: one_generate_call_only; no caller-provided, returned or retained cache
generation.seed_reason: Greedy decoding uses no sampling RNG; initialized learned tensors are exactly overwritten by the pinned pretrained snapshot. Random opaque operation IDs are retained in raw evidence.

syntax_constraint.bounds: Original output reservation, cumulative tokens, steps and wall-clock deadline still apply. Grammar compilation and masking run inside the worker deadline.
syntax_constraint.request_binding: Exact authenticated, advertised public tool definitions; tools and values remain model choices.
syntax_constraint.selection: Greedy model logits masked only by the declared public action JSON grammar; no tokens injected and no posthoc repair.

model_source.normalization: Reviewed lossless BF16-to-F32 learned tensors; explicit tied embedding; no training or corpus conditioning.

qualification_limits.deadline: 300 seconds per child including startup; documented bounded cleanup/authority read and parent artifact publication are separate.
qualification_limits.repeated_error_rate: undefined if there is no observed actual wrong-prior/new-correction opportunity

apache-tvm-ffi.module_version_note: An absent module-level version is recorded as null; selected distribution metadata and imported source bytes are bound separately.
